beats.desc: a hand sets the tip of a blue-handled screwdriver onto the top screw of the black latch faceplate on the edge of the white door while the other hand steadies the screwdriver shaft
the hand turns the blue-handled screwdriver clockwise to drive the screw and tighten the black latch faceplate against the door edge
beats.constraint: the screwdriver tip stays engaged with the faceplate screw and both hands stay at the door edge.

subject: A man in a plain denim work shirt uses a blue-handled screwdriver to fasten the latch faceplate into the edge of an exterior door, working with both hands; the man
scene_keep: the white door, the black latch faceplate on the door edge, the bare-wood cross-bore hole on the door face, the black door knob below, and the bright sunny porch with green foliage and a white railing behind
